name: Hierarchical CT Reconstruction via Partial Line Integrals
aliases: Intermediate data $q_ eta(r, 	heta, t)$ method
definition: An intermediate data representation $q_ eta(r, 	heta, t)$ defined in the partial line integral domain, generated by restricting the line integral with a window function. It serves as a bridge between line integrals (sinograms) and image voxels.
summary: Hierarchical CT Reconstruction via Partial Line Integrals solves tomographic inverse problems using sparse connections to achieve O(n log n) complexity, unlike generic fully connected networks requiring O(n^2) parameters.
